title: [Bug] [Has Workaround] Auto-Compact Resetting Context Limit To 4-6% Causing Frequent Compaction Loop
body:
**Bug Description**
Auto-compact keeps resetting to 4% - 6% remaining so Claude goes into a compact loop. Resetting session did not fix the problem. 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: null
- Version: 1.0.89
- Feedback ID: 112dcd15-a42b-41fc-bcb8-fc37523b3d00

**Errors**
```json
[]
```

**Workaround:** 

Either rename/remove the settings.local.json file from the .claude folder 

OR 

Manually go through the file and cleanup large actions that you don't mind having to approve again regularly. 

OR 

Cleanup the entire file and manually go in an add actions yourself.
author: Codewow

Found a "fix." Not sure how detrimental it is to context awareness, but deleting/renaming the settings.local file in the .claude folder fixed the context issues for me. I am guessing the file just got too large for Claude to be able to effectively read because of all the bash commands it stored away that weren't reusable in most cases.
